question: Should OpenClaw add a `HEARTBEAT.md` task-level model metadata contract, or should heartbeat task routing wait for a broader per-turn/model-router API or plugin hook design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the safe implementation depends on maintainer intent for public syntax, whether due tasks split into separate turns, and how model overrides interact with provider auth, fallbacks, and session state.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable per-turn or heartbeat routing contract before accepting heartbeat-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only task metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow `HEARTBEAT.md` task model field with explicit split/group semantics and compatibility tests.

options.title: Route to plugin-only policy
options.body: Decline core task syntax and document whole-turn routing through `before_model_resolve`, accepting that multiple due tasks cannot be independently routed today.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable per-turn or heartbeat routing contract before accepting heartbeat-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available owner from the history because the decision crosses the model-hook seam and core-vs-plugin product boundary.
